parole.testo: From Middle High German gelücke (12th century), at first along the Lower and Middle Rhine. Probably borrowed from Old Dutch *gilukki as part of the Flemish knight culture; compare Middle Dutch gelucke (1240), whence modern Dutch geluk. parole.testo: Uncertain, perhaps borrowed from Middle Dutch focken (“to breed; to fuck; to tease”) with uncommon sound development of [k] to [p] (influenced either by the preceding rounded vowel or assimilation to the /f/), from Old Dutch *fokkon, from Proto-West Germanic *fukkōn, possibly from Proto-Germanic *fu
